lessons.key: ac_gap::when a component exists with its own passing unit test but is never called from the live request path treat the ac as uncovered add an end to end test that drives the real rpc render path not just the isolated unit
lessons.text: When a component exists with its own passing unit test but is never called from the live request path, treat the AC as uncovered: add an end-to-end test that drives the real RPC/render path, not just the isolated unit.

lessons.key: ac_gap::regex based xml transforms must mask or skip comment spans first add a test that tag like text inside a comment stays inert or comments get corrupted
lessons.text: Regex-based XML transforms must mask or skip <!-- comment --> spans first; add a test that tag-like text inside a comment stays inert, or comments get corrupted.

lessons.key: ac_gap::case insensitive matching must hold on both sides of a boundary if discovery is case insensitive but resolution is case sensitive files are accepted then fail to render test the capital cased variant end to end
lessons.text: Case-insensitive matching must hold on BOTH sides of a boundary: if discovery is case-insensitive but resolution is case-sensitive, files are accepted then fail to render — test the capital-cased variant end-to-end.
evidence: P1-G AC1 (Resources/Layout capital casing) — host resolution case-sensitive (resource-resolution;ecosystem)

lessons.key: ac_gap::build webview resource uris by joining onto the registered localresourceroots uri aswebviewuri uri joinpath root name never via uri file abspath context globalstorageuri is vscode userdata scheme so a file scheme resource under it 401s and test webview resource loading end to end not just img presence
lessons.text: Build webview resource URIs by joining onto the registered localResourceRoots Uri (asWebviewUri(Uri.joinPath(root, name))), never via Uri.file(absPath): context.globalStorageUri is vscode-userdata-scheme, so a file:-scheme resource under it 401s; and test webview resource LOADING end-to-end, not just presence.
